## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and Industrial Strength (proxy: XLI divergence but CPER/energy strength) with CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND confirm a risk-negative near-term read while cycle indicators remain constructive.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress ticking up: HYG (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +0.10%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +1.30%) ABOVE TREND implies HYG/LQD ↓ (credit stress rising) ↓ falling. Commodity/reflation bid supporting cyclicals: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and CPER ABOVE TREND, while VXX rising signals elevated tactical risk.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tighter: TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while SPY (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND leaves SPY/TLT → flat BELOW TREND. Dollar softening slightly but in CORRECTION with UUP (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Utilities and staples lead with XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND and XLP (1W: +2.41% | 1M: +9.34%) ABOVE TREND, while Energy shows strong reflation leadership via XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Financials weak: XLF (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND — style mixed / cyclicals + defensives leading.

5. US vs Global?
US soft: SPY (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND while Europe/ Japan outperform on MTD: EWJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +8.40%) ABOVE TREND and broader Europe metrics ABOVE TREND. China underperformance pronounced: FXI (1W: -3.94% | 1M: -7.95%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND while EEM (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +3.01%) ABOVE TREND — EM vs US mixed.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows mixed: ARKK (1W: +1.99% | 1M: -7.64%) RECOVERY shows selective risk-on breadth, but IBIT (1W: -3.20% | 1M: -26.37%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND indicates crypto/speculative weakness. Small caps struggling: IWM (1W: -1.21% | 1M: -0.72%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND — speculation selective rather than broad-based.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Reflation/energy bid: BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND and CPER ABOVE TREND point to continued commodity support. Precious metals show short-term recovery: GLD (1W: +3.23% | 1M: -2.19%) RECOVERY and SLV (1W: +10.92% | 1M: -19.52%) RECOVERY on volatile flows.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy clear strength: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and UGA/BNO showing gains, while natural gas remains weak with UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Watch commodity-driven cyclicals for continued leadership.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) and TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +4.07%) both timeframes positive. DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION flags (XLI, various mid-/small-cap ETFs and tech semis) create minor-to-moderate dislocations — monitor 1W vs 1M mismatches.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor energy and defensive income exposures (XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND, XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to broad tech beta (XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND) given rotation signals. Bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND) offer duration ballast amid mixed risk signals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.90% | 1M: +11.73%) ABOVE TREND and XLU (1W: +3.02% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND if commodity/defensive flows persist. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND and XLF (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.72%) BELOW TREND if tech/financial earnings or macro catalysts disappoint.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +2.74% | 1M: +9.47%) ABOVE TREND and CPER (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +0.27%) ABOVE TREND on reflation momentum. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -4.08% | 1M: -20.72%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and base/uranium plays still weak (URA BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~30 (elevated fear threshold) with current VXX (1W: +1.87% | 1M: +7.55%) ABOVE TREND; HYG/LQD around 0.72 (current ~0.7228) is a credit-stress pivot ↓ falling; SPY/TLT ~7.55 (current 7.5533) BELOW TREND; XLK/XLF near 2.70 (current 2.6980) is the tech-vs-fin pivot ↓ falling.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, reflation and defensives (XLE ABOVE TREND, XLU ABOVE TREND) showing strength while tech (XLK BELOW TREND) lags. Key risk: rising VXX and HYG/LQD dynamics (credit stress signals) create a tactical backdrop for continued sector rotation — monitor 1W vs 1M divergences.
